question: Dussehra festival is celebrated in which of the following Hindu months?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dussehra** festival is celebrated in the Hindu month of **Ashwin**.
 
• It marks the victory of **Lord Rama** over the demon king **Ravana**.
 
• The festival signifies the triumph of **good over evil **and is celebrated with great enthusiasm across India.
 
• In some regions, it is also known as **Vijayadashami**.
 
• The celebration includes the burning of effigies of Ravana, symbolizing the destruction of evil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Hindu month of **Ashwin** typically falls in the Gregorian months of **September and October**.
 
• Dussehra is the culmination of the **Navratri festival**, which is a **nine-day celebration** dedicated to the worship of the **Goddess Durga**.
 
• It is one of the major festivals in India and is celebrated with various cultural performances, fairs, and processions.
 
• In some parts of India, people also celebrate the victory of Goddess Durga over the** buffalo demon Mahishasura**.
 
• Public celebrations include plays, dance dramas, and colorful processions depicting scenes from the Ramayana.
